Visitor replaces blockquote with custom format

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorCustomBlockquote struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorCustomBlockquote) VisitBlockquote(ctx htmd.NodeContext, content string, depth uint) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(fmt.Sprintf(`QUOTE: "%s"`, content))
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorCustomBlockquote{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<blockquote><p>A wise quote.</p></blockquote>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
